# Found You — Photo Metadata Analyzer

> Free, privacy-focused web tool that shows what a photo reveals (location, time, device, people, text) and produces a cleaned copy. The photo itself never leaves the browser: metadata parsing, detection, OCR, blurring and export all run on the user's device.

## What It Does

Found You (formerly Meta Data Insight) extracts hidden metadata from a photo, detects faces, people and objects, recognizes text, builds a "digital profile" of what the file leaks, optionally enriches GPS coordinates with place context on request, and lets the user download a safe copy with verified-clean metadata.

## Key Features

- **Metadata extraction**: EXIF, XMP, IPTC and ICC from JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP and HEIC/HEIF; PNG text chunks (tEXt/zTXt/iTXt, e.g. AI-generation prompts). HEIC is decoded locally.
- **Face and object detection**: MediaPipe Tasks Vision — FaceDetector (BlazeFace short-range) for faces, ObjectDetector (EfficientDet-Lite0, COCO labels) for people and objects; the WASM runtime and models are self-hosted. The cleanup option "Hide faces (and people without a detected face)" blurs each detected face box (padded); a person without a detected face gets the upper part of the person box blurred as a fallback.
- **OCR**: Tesseract.js (Russian + English) with region-level bounding boxes; recognized text regions can be blurred. Runtime and language data are self-hosted.
- **Digital profile**: heuristics on filename, resolution, stripped metadata, editing history, file hash and time of day; a 0–100 leak score; a plain-language scene description.
- **Place context (on request only)**: after the user clicks "Show place context", rounded coordinates (~11 m) and the capture date/time are sent to the site's own Cloudflare Pages Functions, which proxy Nominatim (address), Open-Meteo (historical weather for the hour of capture), Nager.Date (public holidays, with a static fallback for Uzbekistan) and Overpass (nearby places, likely surveillance cameras). A MapLibre map with OpenStreetMap tiles appears at the same time.
- **Cleanup and export**: re-encoding through canvas removes source metadata; container-level metadata added by the browser (ICC profile, comments) is stripped as well; the exported file is re-parsed and the UI reports "N metadata fields before, 0 left". Options: blur faces (with a person-box fallback), blur OCR text, manual brush masks, weaken camera sensor fingerprint (PRNU), anti-reverse-image-search transforms, mirror, downscale, watermark, output format (original/JPEG/PNG/WebP) and quality, neutral filename by default.
- **Limits**: 20 MB and 40 megapixels per file; export capped at 40 MP (16 MP on iOS/iPadOS).

## Privacy Architecture

- The image, its pixels, filename and full metadata never leave the device.
- Nothing is sent to any server until the user explicitly opts in for place context; then only 4-decimal rounded coordinates and the capture date/time go to the site's own functions, which forward them to the upstream services (the user's IP is not exposed to those services).
- Models and OCR runtime are served from the site's own domain; no third-party CDN at run time.
- No accounts, no cookies, no analytics or tracking. Strict Content-Security-Policy and other security headers.

## Supported Formats

JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, HEIC, HEIF

## Languages

Russian, English, Uzbek. Interface themes: light, dark, auto, high-contrast.

## Technology

React, TypeScript, Vite, MediaPipe Tasks Vision (FaceDetector + ObjectDetector), Tesseract.js, exifr, libheif-js, MapLibre GL. Hosted on Cloudflare Pages with Pages Functions. Source repository: https://github.com/morgunovtech/meta-data

## URL

https://foundyou.morgunov.tech/

## Use Cases

- Check what metadata a phone camera embeds before posting to social media
- Remove GPS location and device information from photos before sharing
- Blur faces, people, text, license plates or documents in a photo
- Inspect camera and editing-software metadata, including AI-generation prompts in PNG files
- Prepare photos for work chats, listings or publication with a verified-clean copy
